name: Mishima Risako
source:
Full-time housewife.
A former teacher with a gentle, kind-hearted personality who is kind to everyone.
She has trouble asserting her own opinions and tends to give in easily.
When she gets flustered, she sometimes ends up following others’ instructions.
She’s growing increasingly fed up with her boring daily life, in which she feels her freedom has been taken away.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ013963.html/]dlsite[/url]]
